summary: Sanction order validity in corruption case; trial stage relevance; Section 19, Prevention of Corruption Act, bars interference in appeal/revision unless failure of justice shown; competency of sanctioning authority is an 'error' under Section 19(4) explanation; High Court erred in quashing proceedings post-trial commencement and after seven witnesses; no finding of failure of justice; proceedings restored; issue of sanction competency to be decided at trial as evidentiary matter.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; criminal proceedings restored before Special Court-Sangrur; trial to proceed from where halted.
